# Sky Stinger

Sky Stinger is the cocky teal-blue Pegasus stallion who tries out for the Wonderbolts with his childhood best friend, Vapor Trail. He genuinely cares about her, but has no idea that she has secretly been helping him perform his impressive aerial tricks. His story is about earning confidence rather than borrowing it.

[![Sky Stinger in Top Bolt — My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, Hasbro/DHX Media](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/20/1495081/medium.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/1495081)

[![Sky Stinger — fan vector by DashieSparkle](https://derpicdn.net/img/2016/10/24/1280380/large.png)](https://www.deviantart.com/dashiesparkle/art/Vector-581-Sky-Stinger-641899241)

- Appearance: Cerulean coat, spiky mint-green mane and tail with pale streaks, green eyes, small mint markings behind his ears, and an upside-down golden lightning-bolt cutie mark. [Color reference](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/212-Sky-Stinger).
- Name and voice: Sky Stinger is his official G4 television name, introduced in dialogue in Top Bolt (October 15, 2016), not a fandom nickname. He has a substantial speaking role, voiced in English by Emmett Hall. [Episode and cast credits](https://watch.plex.tv/nl/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/season/6/episode/24). He jokingly calls himself the princess of flying; this is not a separate identity.
- Later appearances: Parental Glideance (S7E7), Secrets and Pies (S7E23), The Ending of the End – Part 2 (S9E25), and The Last Problem (S9E26), including Rainbow Dash's group in the closing song. He also appears in Gameloft's mobile game. [Character and appearance reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sky_Stinger).

## Important moments

All four scenes are from Top Bolt (S6E24). [Watch the full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165215/s06-e24-top-bolt); individual timestamps could not be verified. [Episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?p=188230).

- The solo trials — Sky boasts about his flying but worries that Vapor will fail without him, revealing both his pride and his affection for his friend.
- The truth comes out — Vapor admits she has secretly helped him fly for years, and his humiliation causes their friendship to fall apart.
- Learning humility — Twilight explains that she also had to work at her own special talent, encouraging Sky to rebuild his confidence through practice.
- Becoming equal wingponies — Sky and Vapor help each other train, pass their individual evaluations, and earn admission to the Wonderbolt Academy.

Image assets were checked directly; the screencap's indexed post and the vector's original artist link were identified, but their host pages blocked direct retrieval. The character wiki was available through its search index only. Vector attribution is independently corroborated by the [Ponyhoof artwork credits](https://jointheherd.little.my/credits).
